text:
Staying in Kiyosumi-Shirakawa, Tokyo's coffee neighbourhood? You get one slow morning: breakfast by the Sumida River at 7:00, or the famous coffee at 8:00. Which would you pick? 👇

🤔 Guess first, then check the answer 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kiyosumi-shirakawa-base-7am-start

🅰️ CLANN BY THE RIVER, 7:00

🥣 A soup-and-bread breakfast on the Sumida River, in the building of LYURO Tokyo Kiyosumi. Card or IC only.

🚶 About 10 minutes from Exit A3. Good for days that start around 7:30, and easiest if you sleep at LYURO itself.

🅱️ BLUE BOTTLE FLAGSHIP CAFE, 8:00

☕ Opens 8:00–19:00 every day, 47 seats.

🌿 Then Kiyosumi Gardens from 9:00 (¥150, last entry 16:30). A proper slow morning.

🚆 AND IF YOU MUST LEAVE AT 7:00?

🍳 Neither. Eat the 6:30 buffet at Comfort Hotel by Exit B1 and catch the 07:05 Hanzomon Line, which starts here: Shibuya 07:28.

👉 All three mornings, with train times:
https://japanbystation.com/kiyosumi-shirakawa-base-7am-start
